Name: Single lane change with prescribed front-wheel steering
Notes: Consumed by single_lane_change.py. Steering_angle_deg is the signed peak FRONT-WHEEL angle, with no steering-wheel ratio conversion. Positive steers left first, followed by a countersteer lobe. Each lobe is sin-squared. This configurable open-loop input is not a digitization of Figure 4 of rollover_2018.pdf; lane displacement is a simulation result.
